reference: He et al. IEEE WCL 2018 Sec.III-A Eqs.(4)-(8); Metzler et al. 2017 Sec.3; matrix adaptation and terminology in docs/TERMINOLOGY.md
adaptation: Full complex AFDM channel, fixed unitary array DFT and invertible temporal representation, shared two-real-channel DnCNNs, per-beam complex matrix correction, frozen population scales and noise intervals.
validation_scope: One trained bank, 16 new physical scenes and 10 paired scenes per SNR; empirical AFDM validity, not a state-evolution or convergence proof
